description: Free-tier endpoint. Returns season-long futures (outright) markets for a sport — championship/Super Bowl/division/conference winners, MVP and award winners, season win totals — aggregated across Bovada, FanDuel, DraftKings, Pinnacle, and Kalshi. One row per (futures event, book, market) with each team/player outcome and its price. Marquee markets (Super Bowl winner, MVP, division/conference) are quoted by multiple books for comparison; exotic markets are often single-book. Useful for: 'who are the Super Bowl favorites across books', 'NFL MVP odds', 'NBA championship futures'. Futures are unresolved (no settlement grade).

sport_key.description: Sport key — e.g. football_nfl, basketball_nba, baseball_mlb.
